exercises.q: Speak of the devil and he is sure to appear.
exercises.ru: ___ чёрта, и он тут как тут.
exercises.why: **Помяни** — помяну́ть (perfective): (dated) to remember, to recall; (colloquial) to mention; (religion) to pray for the health living or the repose of the soul of the dead, to commemorate.

pairs: to remember, to keep in mind
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: припо́мнить — to remember, to recall; упомина́ть — to mention, to refer; запо́мнить — to remember, to keep in mind; помяну́ть — (dated) to remember, to recall.
